crotchLower.name: Crotch lower (%)
crotchLower.help: Lower the crotch depth for a more relaxed fit

ease.name: Ease (%)
ease.help: Amount of ease added to the waist and hips

waistReduction.name: Waist reduction (%)
waistReduction.help: Reduction of the ease around the waist

backCoverage.name: Back coverage (°)
backCoverage.help: Adjust the side angle of the waistband to increase or reduce how much of your bum is covered

crossSeamEase.name: Cross seam ease (%)
crossSeamEase.help: Amount of ease added to the cross seam for comfort

fitLegs.name: Fit legs (%)
fitLegs.help: Adjust the fit of the legs from loose to tight

stretch.name: Fit waist (stretch) (%)
stretch.help: Whether the waist opening will follow the seat circumference or fit to your body

waistbandFrontAngle.name: Waistband front angle (°)
waistbandFrontAngle.help: How curved the waistband is at the front

elasticHeight.name: Elastic height (%)
elasticHeight.help: Height of the elastic used in the waistband

legBalance.name: Leg balance (%)
legBalance.help: Balance between front and back leg width

inseam.name: Inseam (%)
inseam.help: Length of the inseam from crotch to hem

waistHeight.name: Waist height (%)
waistHeight.help: Height of the waistband relative to natural waist

sideSplitOffset.name: Side split offset (%)
sideSplitOffset.help: Determines the height at which the split starts

waistbandExtraWidth.name: Waistband extra width (%)
waistbandExtraWidth.help: Make the waistband tunnel a bit wider than the elastic for easier sewing

splitParts.name: Split parts
splitParts.help: Split the front and back parts into separate pattern pieces

elasticOnlyOnBack.name: Elastic only on back
elasticOnlyOnBack.help: Keep the front free of elastic, only use elastic on the back

pocket.name: Pocket
pocket.help: Which type of front pockets you want
